vendor_company: Unleashed Software (a division of The Access Group)
hq_country: New Zealand (Auckland); parent The Access Group is HQ in the UK
target_vertical: Manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, and product-based SMBs (Xero-first NZ/AU/UK customer base)
pricing_model: Tiered subscription per plan with included user seats; paid add-on modules (Warehouse Management, Production, B2B eCommerce, Advanced Inventory Manager, CRM, Access Analytics); per-channel add-ons (Amazon/WooCommerce) charged per order volume
starting_price_usd: Approx USD $349-$399/month for the entry Essentials/Core plan (NZD/GBP/AUD pricing varies; ~£279/£399 GBP Core tier as of 2025-2026)
free_trial_or_freemium: 14-day free trial (no freemium tier); free trials include the Advanced Inventory Manager module switched on
shopify_supported: Native (direct first-party integration built by Unleashed)
shopify_sync_direction: Configurable per entity: products can be mastered in either Unleashed or Shopify (or disabled); inventory is one-way Unleashed -> Shopify; orders and customers are one-way Shopify -> Unleashed; fulfilment status pushed back Unleashed -> Shopify
shopify_synced_entities: Products and variants, inventory/stock-on-hand, orders, customers, fulfilments/shipments; refunds and credits flow back into Unleashed sales returns; draft orders [uncertain]
shopify_service_item_support: [uncertain] - documentation focuses on physical products; non-physical/service line items are not explicitly documented as a first-class sync entity
shopify_multi_store_support: Yes - multiple Shopify stores can be connected to a single Unleashed tenant, each configured independently
shopify_pos_support: [uncertain] - Shopify POS orders flow in as standard Shopify orders via the API; no dedicated POS-specific workflow documented
shopify_b2b_catalog_support: [uncertain] - no documented native handling of Shopify B2B company locations or price lists
shopify_markets_support: [uncertain] - no specific Shopify Markets (multi-market pricing/duties/landed cost) handling documented
shopify_metafield_to_erp_field_mapping: [uncertain] - no documented generic metafield <-> custom field mapping; not a marketed feature
shopify_variant_option_mapping: Each Shopify variant is created as a unique product code (SKU) in Unleashed; mappings are established at setup time and can be edited
shopify_real_time_or_batch: Polled/batched - stock availability syncs to Shopify on a configurable interval (default ~15 minutes); orders sync when the shop status is set to open
shopify_known_limitations: Community reports order-syncing and fulfilment problems; integration can conflict with third-party Shopify apps; high additional cost on top of base subscription; limited handling of Shopify-specific features like Markets/B2B; complex setup with steep learning curve; some users supplement with third-party connector TIDE for enhanced functionality
etsy_native_or_third_party: Third-party - via TIDE (tideconnects.com), an Unleashed marketplace partner
etsy_listing_creation_vs_sync_only: [uncertain] - TIDE typically syncs existing listings rather than creating new ones
etsy_inventory_sync: Inventory sync from Unleashed to Etsy via TIDE; frequency and depth depend on TIDE configuration (real-time, scheduled, or manual options)
etsy_order_import: Etsy orders imported into Unleashed via TIDE; schedule configurable (real-time, scheduled, or manual)
etsy_synced_entities: Listings, inventory, orders, shipments/tracking back to Etsy (via TIDE); variations and personalization support [uncertain]
etsy_known_limitations: Requires paid third-party TIDE subscription on top of Unleashed; not a native Unleashed integration; Etsy-specific edge cases (variations, personalization, digital products) not deeply documented
amazon_marketplaces: [uncertain] - integration is global via Amazon Seller Central; specific supported marketplaces (US, UK, EU, AU, CA, etc.) not enumerated in public docs
amazon_seller_types: FBM and FBA both supported; orders can be separated and managed differently depending on fulfilment process; Vendor Central [uncertain - likely not supported]
amazon_synced_entities: Products/listings (existing), inventory/stock-on-hand, orders, customer information; shipments, settlements, returns and messaging [uncertain]
amazon_listing_creation: Sync-only - existing Amazon listings are matched to Unleashed products; the integration is primarily about inventory and order sync rather than listing creation
amazon_buy_shipping: Not supported - no in-app Amazon Buy Shipping label purchase
amazon_fba_inbound_workflow: [uncertain] - FBA inbound shipment creation workflow not prominently documented; users typically manage inbound in Seller Central and reconcile in Unleashed
amazon_sp_api_inbound_v2024_03_20: [uncertain] - migration status to the new Fulfillment Inbound v2024-03-20 API not publicly documented
amazon_settlement_report_handling: [uncertain] - Amazon settlement reports and reconciliation are not a documented native feature; users typically rely on third-party tools (e.g. A2X) for settlement reconciliation to Xero/QBO
amazon_marketplace_facilitator_tax_handl: [uncertain] - marketplace facilitator tax handling not documented as a first-class feature
amazon_multi_account_support: Yes - by default up to 5 Amazon shops/accounts can be connected per Unleashed tenant; each store configured independently
amazon_known_limitations: Paid add-on (~£30/month plus per-order fees); listing creation not supported; limited public documentation on FBA inbound, settlements, and tax handling; users often pair with A2X for accurate Amazon-to-accounting reconciliation
xero_supported: Native (Xero is a flagship integration; Unleashed is one of Xero's most established inventory app partners)
xero_app_store_certified: Yes - listed on Xero App Store (apps.xero.com/app/unleashed-software); a long-standing Xero partner
xero_app_awards_recognition: Won Xero Awards 'Small Business App of the Year' (2019); historical Xero App Partner of the Year recognition. 2025 Xero Global App Award status [uncertain]
xero_app_store_rating: [uncertain] - Xero App Store rating and review count not captured in collected sources
xero_synced_entities: Customers, suppliers, sales invoices, purchase invoices/bills, payments, stock journals (COGS/inventory movements), credit notes and returns, tax codes; customer credit limits and outstanding invoice balances bidirectionally synced
xero_accounting_sync_mode: invoice_per_order - each Unleashed sale creates a corresponding Xero invoice; bills mirrored 1:1; stock journals posted as separate manual journals (not summary/A2X style)
xero_cogs_journal_method: perpetual_per_movement - Unleashed uses average landed cost methodology and posts COGS journals to Xero as inventory movements occur; landed cost inclusive (freight, duties allocated to stock value); recosting after receipt is supported
xero_multi_currency: Yes - multi-currency sales and purchase posting supported
xero_tracking_category_mapping: Yes - configurable Xero Tracking Categories can be mapped from Unleashed dimensions (e.g. warehouse, product group, sales channel) for enhanced P&L reporting
xero_tax_handling: Tax codes synced in real time between Unleashed and Xero; GST/VAT/sales tax mapped at customer/supplier and product level
xero_known_limitations: Changes made to transactions in Xero after sync are not pushed back to Unleashed and can create variances; one-time setup required to map COA accounts; complex setup for businesses with non-standard chart of accounts
qb_desktop_supported: No - QuickBooks Desktop not supported (cloud-only integration with QuickBooks Online)
qb_app_certified: Listed on Intuit App Store / QuickBooks App Store (appcenter.intuit.com/unleashedsoftware); specific certification badges [uncertain]
qb_synced_entities: Customers, suppliers/vendors, sales invoices, purchase invoices/bills, payments, stock journals (COGS/inventory), credit notes/credit memos, returns
qb_accounting_sync_mode: invoice_per_order - each Unleashed sale creates a corresponding QBO invoice; not summary-journal style
qb_cogs_journal_method: perpetual_per_movement - same average landed cost methodology used for Xero applied to QBO postings; landed cost inclusive
qb_multi_currency: Yes - multi-currency supported (requires QBO Essentials or higher)
qb_class_location_mapping: [uncertain] - Class/Location dimension mapping equivalent to Xero Tracking Categories not explicitly documented
qb_known_limitations: Requires QBO Essentials tier or higher; only one QBO account can be connected per Unleashed tenant and is not switchable after connection; changes made in QBO after sync are not pushed back and cause variances
other_ecom_channels: Native: Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon. Via TIDE (third-party connector): BigCommerce, Magento, Visualsoft, eBay, TikTok Shop, Etsy, Lightspeed Retail. Walmart, Wix, Squarespace, Faire, Square [uncertain - likely via Zapier/n8n/Make custom workflows only]
bundle_kit_component_decomposition: Yes - 'Auto-Assembly' BOMs allow bundles/kitsets to be built on the fly; component stock is automatically decremented when the assembled product is sold or when an assembly is completed
other_accounting_integrations: Native: Xero, QuickBooks Online. NetSuite via third-party (Breadwinner). Sage 50/Intacct, Zoho Books, MYOB, FreshBooks, Wave [uncertain - not documented as native]
bom_support: Yes - core feature; Bills of Material with automatic product costing
production_orders: Yes - Assembly/production orders with Kanban planning boards; supports make-to-order and make-to-stock; auto-assemblies (no BOM required) and BOM-based assemblies; production is an add-on module in some plans (~$69/month)
batch_lot_tracking: Yes - industry-recognized batch/lot tracking with expiry dates, production date, supplier/manufacturer details, storage conditions, location, QC status, and compliance records
serial_tracking: Yes - serial numbers can be attached to both components and assembled products; full transaction history maintained
bin_location_support: Yes - basic bin location (one bin per product per warehouse) in core product; advanced multi-level zone/aisle/rack/bay/bin tracking available via the Warehouse Management add-on app (~$149/month)
multi_warehouse: Yes - unlimited warehouses included across all plans; multi-location stock visibility
barcoding: Yes - barcode generation and label printing; compatible with most 1D barcode scanners; users report some limitations vs dedicated WMS scanner workflows
purchase_orders: Yes - PO creation, partial receipts, supplier price lists, supplier-SKU mapping, lead times
supplier_management: Yes - supplier records with lead times, MOQs, supplier-SKU mapping, supplier pricing, credit terms
landed_cost_support: Yes - freight, customs, duty, insurance and other costs allocated to inventory cost; uses average landed cost methodology; recosting feature allows costs to be added after goods have been receipted
multi_currency_inventory_valuation: [uncertain] - multi-currency transactions supported but valuation is held in the tenant base currency
ai_demand_forecasting: Yes - via the Advanced Inventory Manager (AIM) add-on module: predictive analytics for demand scenarios, identifies top revenue-earning products, builds forecasts from historical data, component demand planning linked to product forecasts, MRP that factors in sales commitments, production duration, supplier lead times
ai_purchase_order_suggestions: Yes - AIM includes intelligent min-max levels at scale, MRP-driven replenishment suggestions, and different strategies per warehouse/product group/supplier
ai_natural_language_query: [uncertain] - no documented chat-style natural language inventory query feature as of 2026
public_api: Yes - public REST API (apidocs.unleashedsoftware.com) supporting JSON and XML; full endpoint documentation available. Note: API does not support partial updates - full payloads required
webhook_event_coverage: Yes - outbound webhooks documented with HMAC-SHA256 signed payloads; 5-minute timestamp window for verification; 72-hour retry with exponential backoff; eventNotificationId for deduplication. Specific event types covered [uncertain - see apidocs.unleashedsoftware.com/Webhooks]
integration_architecture: Hybrid: core integrations (Xero, QBO, Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon) are native/first-party; long-tail channels (Etsy, eBay, BigCommerce, Magento, TikTok Shop, Walmart) handled via partner connector TIDE; also supported via iPaaS (Zapier, Make, n8n, Zoho Flow, Stacksync)
zapier_make_support: Yes - Zapier, Make.com, n8n, Zoho Flow, and Stacksync connectors all available
mobile_app: Yes - Unleashed Sales app (iOS/Android) for sales reps; separate Warehouse Management app (paid add-on, ~$149/month) for warehouse operations
mobile_barcode_scanning_app: Yes - dedicated Warehouse Management app supports barcode scanning, pick/pack/ship, stocktake, transfers; available as a paid add-on module
rate_limit_handling_documented: [uncertain] - vendor's handling of Shopify/Amazon/Xero/QBO upstream rate limits not prominently documented; outbound Unleashed API rate limits documented
sync_frequency: Shopify inventory: ~15-minute polled intervals (configurable); WooCommerce: ~15-minute intervals; Amazon: scheduled; Xero/QBO: real-time on transaction creation; webhooks: real-time with 72-hour retry
shipping_carrier_integrations: Via partners rather than direct: Starshipit (native marketplace integration; connects to DHL, AusPost, NZ Post, Royal Mail, FedEx, UPS, etc.); ShipStation via third-party connectors (Extensiv, etc.); other carriers via Zapier/n8n/Make
shipping_label_buying: Not in-app - label purchase handled via partner platforms like Starshipit or ShipStation
three_pl_integrations: [uncertain] - no documented native 3PL integrations (ShipBob, ShipHero, Extensiv, Deliverr); typically integrated via API or third-party connectors
edi_support: [uncertain] - no native EDI support documented; typically handled via third-party EDI providers integrating to the Unleashed API
notable_customers: Flowstore (case study for AIM/demand forecasting); other named customers [uncertain]
last_major_release: [uncertain] - no single dated major release identified; ongoing module-based development (AIM, Warehouse Management, B2B eCommerce Store, Shopify Product Synchronization improvements 2024-2025)
owner_parent_company: The Access Group (UK-based private equity-backed software group); acquired Unleashed Software on 2020-11-12
last_funding_event: Acquired by The Access Group on 2020-11-12 (terms undisclosed). No subsequent funding events as a standalone entity
public_status_page_uptime: [uncertain] - public status page URL not located in research; vendor may publish via The Access Group umbrella status page
